notes.title: End of Support - Follow-Up Notice
notes.content:
Thank you for your questions and concerns regarding [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916210/announcements/detail/2978557317977124542]the end of developer support for Fabrication[/url].

The reason why I am concerned is because I do not wish to leave the game in a state which will make players think they have wasted their money because I won't be able to provide support and I know the game isn't perfect.

So I thought of the following options:

- Drastic decrease in price
- Discount sale
- Release for free
- Unlist the game 

Unfortunately, the game cannot be released for free. Because players have expressed concern over being unable to play the game should it be unlisted, I have decided not to take this action either. It's possible that I could remove the game from the Steam store, but to do so would require a fair bit of preparation and Valve's approval.

Instead of having a sale, [b]I have come to the following conclusion:[/b]

- Fabrication's price will be decreased as much as it can.

From (06/03/2021 - [time at which the price was altered]):

5.99 USD
4.79 GBP
4.99 EUR

Will be reduced to (from [time at which the price was altered] - present day):

1.99 USD
1.69 GBP
1.59 EUR

This approval is currently pending. If it's at the aforementioned changed price, then this means that this change has already took effect.

This is my final action for the game.

The game is still worthy of a price point but I would like as many people to play as possible.

Thank you for your support. I am glad to have put effort in both games! It was a very interesting journey, and one that was worth it for me to take.

notes.title: Thank You, Soundtrack Release and The Future
notes.content:
[h1]Thank You[/h1]

Thank you to all players who have purchased Fabrication.

On January 6th 2021, Fabrication recouped it's development cost just 26 days after release at 11th December 2020. Thanks to all who bought the game. :)

I told myself that sales isn't really the reason I made this game, but the fact that it recouped it's cost and is now turning a profit has made it worth the years I have spent on this project.

I have also received feedback from the United States players, saying that there are impressed and happy with the game. Thank you!
I will be releasing the Fabrication soundtrack sometime in 2021, this will be a free DLC.

There's also a long-awaited update that released to White Pearl... the quest journal, that released on January 29th. I'm sorry it took years to add this to White Pearl (laughs). Thanks to all 25k players of White Pearl for their support and feedback on this experiment.

[b]Regarding further feedback[/b]

If you wish to leave feedback for the game, please do so in a game review. 

[b]Regarding game updates[/b]

White Pearl was lucky enough to receive multiple major updates and patches throughout it's lifetime, along with the last major update, 2.10: The Quest Journal Patch, releasing on 29th January 2021.

Because of reduced player response and a lack of personal time, Fabrication will have no major updates, only bug fixes patches sporadically. 

[b]Regarding possible future titles[/b]

There are currently no plans to develop another game in the Chronicles of Ottrea series.

[h1]Fabrication - Soundtrack
[/h1]
The Fabrication soundtrack will be released sometime in 2021.

This will be a free DLC that is automatically added when you purchase/download the game.

notes.title: Fabrication - Now Available!
notes.content:
Thank you for waiting.

Fabrication is now released to the world. I've had a few questions asking if they should play White Pearl, and instead I would like you to try Fabrication first as it mostly improves upon this game. You are also able to understand the story without playing White Pearl.

However, for fans who have played White Pearl, the story still continues from that game in Fabrication... Please play to find out more!

- 15-20 hour RPG
- Over 20 sidequests to complete
- Over 50 achievements to obtain
- Turn-based combat
- Deep, character-driven story to experience
- A large world to explore, separated into 3 Districts:
 
 -> The Ry'ner District & The Land of the Light
 -> The Kolan District & The Kresniks' Headquarters
 -> The Terra District at the Ends of the Earth

There's lots of lore, story and characters in this game so please enjoy! I have made lots of cutscenes and story that is more enjoyable than the previous game! Have fun!
Plus: there's a lot of side content towards the end, so enjoy sinking your teeth into that!

If you would like to post a bug report, do so in the bug megathread.

If you have any questions are concerns, drop them in this thread.

If you want to give feedback, leave a review. It increases the chances of me making a new project (if I decide to do so)!

Fabrication is releasing around 10AM GMT time / 4AM PST time or earlier.

Enjoy, 

- Harry
